Notes: Quest-Start per Story Manager; Zaehlung verschoben, weil dialogue/Q00.csv Stage 10 jetzt bis 010_73 reicht. Quest-Log-Text: "Someone has walked through the Black Door without an invitation. Nazir has a blade at her throat."

Speaker: Journal

Speaker: Journal
Text: Consult the Night Mother about Veyra.
Notes: Fortsetzung der Sequenz aus Q00.csv Stage 20 (bis 40 dort). Quest-Log-Text: "The stranger calls herself Veyra Othren, the Gleaner. She asked me to let the Night Mother judge her."

Speaker: Journal

Notes: Fortsetzung der Sequenz aus Q00.csv Stage 30; erst Veyra im Windpeak Inn holen, danach Proposal in der Sanctuary. Quest-Log-Text: "The Night Mother spoke for the Gleaner. It is my choice what to do with her."

Notes: Fortsetzung der Sequenz aus Q00.csv Stage 40 (bis 01 dort). Quest-Log-Text: "Veyra wants to rebuild the family with killers she has been watching across Skyrim. First, she wants to open a passage hidden behind a wall that is not a wall."

Speaker: Journal
Notes: Fortsetzung der Sequenz aus Q00.csv Stage 50 (bis 06 dort). Quest-Log-Text: "Behind the veil lies an old Nordic vault, far older than the Sanctuary. It was not empty."

Speaker: Journal

Speaker: Journal
Text: Investigate the bodies in Windhelm's harbor.
Notes: Veyra says Windhelm's harbor has given back four bodies this season. The guards blame the cold. Veyra does not. Torbjorn's ledger points toward repeated violence at the docks.

Speaker: Journal
Notes: A new body was pulled from the water this morning. The dockworkers say the knots are worth a look. Bruises and a hurried fisherman's hitch suggest the drowning followed a fight.

Speaker: Journal
Notes: The knot is a marsh hitch, an Argonian fisherman's knot. The killer works after dark.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Follow the killer without being seen.
Notes: I saw an Argonian drag a man into the harbor. If I follow him, he may lead me to his hiding place.

Speaker: Journal
Notes: The killer hides beneath the docks in a place he calls the Drowned Hollow.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Help Sings-Beneath-Ice kill Aelius the harbor clerk.
Notes: Veyra's test: Sings-Beneath-Ice must kill the one man at the docks who treated Argonians fairly. Aelius's kindness is genuine, even if his reasons are not simple.

Speaker: Journal
Notes: Aelius kept a list in his desk. It changes what we know about him, but it does not erase the choice Sings made.

Speaker: Journal
Notes: I should tell Veyra how it ended.
